// diagnostic

E2428

A `#here` parameter default names the declaration, not the call.

What

A `#here` parameter default names the declaration, not the call.

Why

`#here` is the place where it is written, so every call that leaves the parameter out would get the default's own line.

Fix

Write the default as `#caller` to get the place of each call.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2428: tests/ui/here_site_default.stderr.

 Fix: Write the default as `#caller` to get the place of each call.
